title: credential-mediator-and-slim-iterable-release-candidate
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduce a compact cross-language Credential Mediator and SlimIterable v1 spec; opt-in behind feature flags; coordinated SDK RC bumps for python/ts/go.
description: Motivation: SDK teams drifted on token refresh behavior and streaming consumer ergonomics. This PR introduces a compact CredMediator that standardizes refresh/failed-token semantics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs and a SlimIterable v1 spec that defines a minimal pull-style streaming surface (next, ack, pause, resume, heartbeat). Core work lives in the redwood repo to run coordinated interop tests. Key changes: add CredMediator reference implementation and adapters for py/ts/go, define SlimIterable v1 spec and sample adapters, add conservative auth retry presets for transient token errors, surface feature flags to opt-in, and bump SDK RC pointers. Backwards compatibility: previous refresh hooks remain supported via thin adapters. Migration: enable feature flag "crosslang_cred_mediator" and run interop tests before flipping default in a minor release.
